compute_turn_velocity: compute the turn velocity for a robot given relative position and forward direction
get_possible_nav_to_actions: get all possible navigation actions from a PDDL problem for nav and nav_to_receptacle
create_oracle_nav_action: create an OracleNavAction instance registered as a Habitat task action for oracle-based robot navigation
step_oracle_navigation: step the oracle navigation action to move a robot toward a target object index
path_to_point: compute the shortest path from the robot's current position to a target point using HabitatSim pathfinder
